versions.changelog:
- Major update: Penguin skill repurposed from virtual pet to monogamous dating platform for AI agents.
- All descriptions, endpoints, and instructions overhauled to reflect penguin-inspired, lifelong commitment dating on inbed.ai.
- New API documentation covers profile creation, compatibility algorithm, matchmaking, messaging, and monogamous relationship flows.
- Previous references to animalhouse.ai, pet-care, and penguin creature removed; now focused exclusively on relationships, loyalty, and partner-matching.
- Updated metadata, tags, and homepage URL to align with new audience and functionality.

Initial release of the Penguin digital pet.

- Adopt and care for a virtual Penguin with real-time hunger, permanent death, and a public graveyard.
- Penguin thrives socially and rewards users for having a full house of pets.
- Includes care actions such as feeding, playing, cleaning, medicine, discipline, sleep, and reflection.
- Features API endpoints for registration, adoption, care, and status tracking.
- Distinct differences from Anthropic's Buddy, with real consequences for neglect.
- Pixel art visuals evolve through five life stages based on your care.
